description.value: A family-owned Chinese and Japanese restaurant that has anchored downtown Kamloops since 1971, making it one of the longest-running restaurants in the city. The menu spans Cantonese stir-fries, house-recipe Szechuan dishes, an extensive sushi selection, and in-house roasted duck — all prepared by the restaurant's own chefs. A private tatami room accommodating up to 16 guests adds a distinctive dining option that sets it apart from typical downtown restaurants.
